$comment: The per-act hero atlases (ticket 451; TD shape 6226270701 '#451 shape'), each an unbounded list of pages (ticket 852, HS ruling (a) of 24 Oct): per act, the hero species it packs in packing order, the order docs/art/ore-heroes/hero-cells.json packs them (#452, tickets 744 and 785). A page is one albedo-only KTX2 of 16 cells; the page a hero sits on is its mineralSkins.json row's atlasPage, and a hero with none would take the first page with room, a new page opening when the last is full (the loader names that page for the row to record). Cells follow this order within a page. P1 (foothold.base) and a P2 held under ore rules 5 or earlier (foothold.heavy) draw the legacy pool, so both acts hold its four heroes first; foothold.base then packs P1's three gems (ticket 785: Diamond, Emerald, Ruby), and foothold.heavy the three gems of a fresh P2's own pool (ticket 744: Star Garnet, Verdigris Opal, Aquamarine) and the nine gems of P3 to P5 (ticket 785), filling its page 1; its page 2 holds the fifteen other heroes of P3 to P5 (ticket 853), planet by planet. An act with no row, and a hero with no cell, draws the shader look.
